title: A 9-Day Journey Through Time
subtitle: From urban bustle to mountain tranquility, every day is a new discovery.

days.title: Departure
days.details: Fly from San Francisco (SFO) to Taiwan Taoyuan (TPE) on China Airlines flight CI003.

days.title: On the plane: crossing the International Date Line
days.details: The magical power of the International Date Line allows us to leap over the time difference and arrive directly at Taiwan's early morning. Take advantage of this airborne time to rest well and recharge for the upcoming cultural exploration and exciting adventures.

days.title: Taipei: Where Tradition Meets Modernity
days.details: Arrive in Taiwan, explore Dihua Street's New Year market, and ascend Taipei 101.

days.title: Taoyuan: Taiwanese New Year Festival Experience
days.details: Experience the festive traditions of both traditional markets and modern malls, make snacks by hand, and gather together to enjoy the warmth of a reunion dinner.

days.title: Miaoli: Crafts & Country Fun
days.details: Experience making oil-paper umbrellas and enjoy the fun of strawberry picking.

days.title: Chiayi: Cloud Walk & Tea Aroma
days.details: Challenge the Taiping Suspension Bridge, taste high-mountain tea, and explore an old street.

days.title: Tainan: Charm of the Ancient Capital
days.details: Visit Tainan Confucius Temple, Anping Fort, and taste traditional snacks on an old street.

days.title: Tainan Outskirts: Hot Springs & Natural Wonders
days.details: Experience the Guanziling mud hot spring and see the Water and Fire Cave natural wonder.

days.title: Taoyuan: Cultural Fusion & Preparation
days.details: Experience Yunnan culture, shop for souvenirs, and prepare for departure.
